## VNB Ranked in American Banker’s 2026 Top-Performing Banks List


Virginia National Bank ranked in the top 100 of **[American Banker](https://www.americanbanker.com/) 's** **2026 Top-Performing Banks** in the country with under $2B in assets.


Being recognized in our own industry is truly an honor. At Virginia National Bank, we are committed to helping you grow your money and keeping it safe. This honor demonstrates that we take that job very seriously.


Thank you for trusting us, thank you American Banker for the recognition, AND


### Congratulations to our amazing team!


*The list was created using the S&P Global Market Intelligence data compiled and analyzed by the consulting firm Capital Performance Group (CPG). The banks were ranked based on their three-year average return on average equity, or ROAE, using year-end 2025 data.*
